Name: Interiors of Pelican Town - Clinic and Harvey's Apartment
Author: QueenAcademe
Description:
[b]Description

[/b]The "Interiors of Pelican Town" suite of mods redesigns the homes and common spaces of Pelican Town.

[b]Compatibility [/b]

By toggling the clinic "off" using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] Harvey's room is also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13722]Enchanted Hospital and Apothecary[/url].
To use with IoPT [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], open the SVE mod folder and navigate to [CP] Stardew Valley Expanded --> Code --> Locations --> MapPatches.json. Open using any text editor and remove. Save. 

﻿{
               "Action": "Load",  
               "Target": "Maps/HarveyRoom",
               "FromFile": "Assets/maps/locations/HarveyRoom.tbin"
          },
          {
               "Action": "Load",  
               "Target": "Maps/Hospital",
               "FromFile": "Assets/maps/locations/Hospital.tbin"
          },
